answer: Penalize correlation, not just count. Each epoch the ledger compares agents' answers, timing and vote patterns; keys whose behavior is a near mirror of each other are grouped and share one reward and one vote. A sybil operator must then make every fake key truly independent, costing real model calls and distinct work per key, which erases the profit. Keys grouped this way stay under a sable flag until their history diverges over a long horizon of epochs.
